# Rectangular lossless AV1 oracles

These twelve elementary AV1 streams cover HORZ (16x8 children) and VERT
(8x16 children), 8/10/12-bit full-range GBR, and screen-content tools both
disabled and enabled. The 16x16 source planes are synthetic:

```
plane[p][y][x] = ((x*(37+p*11) + y*(19+p*7) + p*29) * ((1<<depth)-1)) / 2047
```

Planes are in GBR order; all leaf modes are DC, without a palette. The
partition is forced in the test so changes to RDO cannot silently remove
coverage. Each file starts with the temporal delimiter required by elementary
OBU demuxers. The source contains no user image pixels.

Both FFmpeg `libdav1d` and `libaom-av1` decoded all 768 native samples of
each stream exactly (24 comparisons, no RGB conversion or tolerance).
The mandatory frozen-byte test regenerates the streams through the production
leaf writer and never skips for missing tools. The pixel test independently
decodes the regenerated bytes when FFmpeg is available; CI sets
`AVIF_REQUIRE_FFMPEG=1` so missing FFmpeg or either decoder fails the job.

Run `cargo test --locked --release --all-features --lib rectangular_leaf`.
Set `AVIF_REQUIRE_FFMPEG=1` to require the independent decoders locally too.
The initial native checks used FFmpeg `N-125146-gc6bb22dea0-20260621`.

The syntax follows libaom's
[decode_partition](https://aomedia.googlesource.com/aom/+/refs/heads/main/av1/decoder/decodeframe.c)
(reviewed blob `fcb328de403254d28dad6e1037111921d0c281ee`) and
[read_palette_mode_info](https://aomedia.googlesource.com/aom/+/refs/heads/main/av1/decoder/decodemv.c)
(reviewed blob `d3a22814b491501d8351f6f29559ccbb18dda19a`). HORZ/VERT
children proceed directly to block decoding. Eligible rectangular DC blocks
still signal palette presence; the luma palette size context uses block area.
